Show less Read more Like 55 Dislike Reply · 2 replies · Hide replies · 2 replies @Lawyerboyleslie72 13 days ago (edited) ALEX is a predictability machine mapping the path to humanities' survival, a path to avoid the second Act of the apocalypse descibed by the climate scientist. Nose bleeds in the story signify points on that path where someone using ALEX makes a choice between two outcomes. The first nose bleed is at the point will Billy can chose to kill Link or not. ALEX chooses for Billy not to kill Link and Billy gets a nose bleed. Next comes the choice between Xavier crashing the plane or Xavier making it to Atlanta? ALEX chooses to have Xavier crash and Xavier gets a nose bleed. Then there is the choice of Link taking Annie with him or leaving her behind. ALEX chooses to leave Annie behind and Link gets a nose bleed. At some point Billy will be asked to kill someone he loves and can't kill but ALEX has predicted the death is necessary in order for humanity to stay on the path to survival. When ALEX sees that Billy is incapable of making the kill that must be made, ALEX must create a backup assassin that will make the necessary kill to keep humanity on the path to survival. So ALEX sends the circuit city email knowing Don will confront Jane's mom at the hospital. That confrontation puts Jane's mom on her path to mistreat Jane her whole life, turning Jane into a killer and the backup assassin ALEX needs at some point for a kill that Billy could not do in order to keep humanity on the path to survival. I believe Sinatra is the one controlling ALEX and making the choices to control humanities' path, trying to insure that humanity survives.
